summary:
Today, farmers face the cost of producing thousands of crops or overcoming missing breakthroughs just to get the right parts for their fields. TerraRotate makes this smart farming accessible to everyone. Its AI-powered decision-making system combines NASA's daily satellite climate conditions and USDA's detailed soil maps in seconds with your field selection on the map.

Without wasting time on complex technical details, it analyzes your field's past crop patterns; instantly identifying the most ideal perennial crop rotation and the most profitable manipulations to prevent yield loss. More than just software, this platform is your field's most reliable guide against climate temperature and soil fatigue, connecting sustainability in agriculture with a healthy future. Are you ready to fully unlock your field's potential?
details:
Imagine a world where every farmer holds the predictive power of global satellite constellations and federal soil surveys right in their hand—transforming agricultural guesswork into climate-resilient science. TerraRotate is an intelligent decision-support system that crafts optimal, multi-year crop rotation strategies tailored to the unique physiological and meteorological fingerprint of specific farm fields. By guiding users through a seamless workflow of setting seasonal goals, outlining field boundaries on interactive maps, and integrating real-time federal data, the platform eliminates the need for expensive manual consulting and delivers instant, actionable insights.

At its core, TerraRotate bridges cutting-edge Earth observation with everyday farm management. Built using Python and Streamlit, the application pulls live daily meteorological records from the NASA POWER API and high-resolution edaphic data from the USDA NRCS SSURGO database, while incorporating satellite-based crop history through the USDA NASS CDL. This strict ground-truth philosophy ensures that every score—from water efficiency to soil protection—reflects verifiable physical reality rather than unverified commercial guesses. Furthermore, innovative features like an interactive What-If scenario simulator allow growers to stress-test their rotation plans against simulated future warming and drought.

The intended impact of TerraRotate is to democratize precision agriculture, safeguarding global soil health and water security under intensifying climatic pressures. By making verified environmental intelligence freely accessible through a clean web interface, our mission is to empower producers everywhere to maintain high yields, protect natural resources, and build truly sustainable farming futures.
